відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"The light blue shoes you asked for are the focus of the evening, and the pale blue top echoes them, so the colour reads as a deliberate choice. The soft beige bag and the silver chain stay quiet beside them. The camel skirt and belt keep the rest warm and calm, which suits an evening at the theatre. The belt marks your waist, and the skirt falls to a calm line down to the shoes, so the outfit has a clear line from waist to ankle.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Tuck the top into the skirt and fasten the belt over it, so the waist is clearly marked.\",\"Wear the necklace over the open collar of the top, so the chain sits on the placket and doesn't compete with the collar.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[\"#335·20\"],\"swap\":{\"item\":\"#335·20\",\"why\":\"kind\",\"to\":\"#443·09\"},\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#443·09\",\"what\":\"light blue long-sleeve polo top\"},{\"n\":\"#213·09\",\"what\":\"camel skirt\"},{\"n\":\"#303·16\",\"what\":\"belt\"},{\"n\":\"#347·15\",\"what\":\"light blue pumps\"},{\"n\":\"#90·07\",\"what\":\"beige bag\"},{\"n\":\"#301·33\",\"what\":\"silver chain necklace\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#443·09\",\"text\":\"A softly collared top in pale blue is smart enough for the theatre, and it brings the colour of your requested shoes up to your face so the blue doesn't stand alone.\"},{\"n\":\"#213·09\",\"text\":\"A midi skirt with a gently flared line gives an evening-ready silhouette and carries your eye down to the shoes you wanted.\"},{\"n\":\"#303·16\",\"text\":\"The belt is the anchor for the outfit: it marks the waist and keeps the skirt and top from reading as one block.\"},{\"n\":\"#347·15\",\"text\":\"These are the light blue shoes you asked for, and they are the accent of the whole outfit; their lifted heel suits an evening out.\"},{\"n\":\"#90·07\",\"text\":\"A small bag in a neutral tone holds what you need for the theatre and stays out of the way of the colour at your feet.\"},{\"n\":\"#301·33\",\"text\":\"A silver chain adds a bit of evening shine near the face and finishes the neckline without making the outfit fussy.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":22568,"output_tokens":1707},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
